note: Rewritten from the English description by Sands (1959); the original is in English, the alate section supplements Sjöstedt's description, and the soldier section records the variation and measurements without restating the whole form; the scan reads decimal points as colons and mixes hyphens with colons (e.g. "1:04-1:22", "0-:72—0:93"), and the measurements have been restored to ranges from the column positions and the means, without adopting the means; Sjöstedt's Gold Coast record, which the original notes could not be verified, is not adopted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The mandibular tooth of the soldier projects less strongly than in A. truncatidens, A. evuncifer and A. importunus; the fore coxa of both soldier and worker lacks spines, which separates the species from A. messinae and A. spinifer. The shape and proportions of the head capsule and mandibles of the soldier are highly variable. The type or topotype specimens of A. elongatus, A. limpopoensis, A. meruensis and A. macrocephalus, together with numerous A. unidentatus specimens, form a continuous series of variation, and all are reduced to synonyms of this species.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: The following supplements Sjöstedt's original description: fontanelle larger than an ocellus, highly variable, ranging from flat to deeply concave, sometimes very large and more than half the eye diameter; postclypeus inflated, posterior margin convex, sides slightly undulate, anterior margin straight; the third marginal tooth of the left mandible distinct, the distance between the apical tooth and the first marginal tooth usually less than that between the first and third marginal teeth; antennae 14—15-segmented. Measurements (mm): head width including eyes 1.04—1.22; maximum diameter of eye 0.26—0.32; ocelli 0.07—0.09 × 0.09—0.13; ocellus to eye 0.05—0.09; pronotum width 0.86—1.11, length 0.56—0.75; hind tibia length 1.04—1.33; forewing length 8.40—12.0.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: The shape and proportions of the head capsule and mandibles are highly variable. Head in dorsal view usually nearly rectangular; in lateral view continuously curved from the fontanelle to the occiput, the anterior curvature shallower. The mandibular tooth of the soldier ranges from projecting to nearly obsolete. The fore coxa of both soldier and worker lacks spines. Measurements (mm): head length 1.13—1.79; maximum head width 0.96—1.39; head width at the mandible base 0.72—0.93; head thickness 0.75—1.11; left mandible length 0.66—0.90; pronotum length 0.32—0.47, width 0.57—0.84; hind tibia length 0.87—1.14.
